title: 9 Things a Godly Man Does Before Anyone Asks Him To
caption:
Nine things a godly man does before it's ever his job to.

He apologizes first. He takes the shift nobody wanted. He shows up before the group chat asks. None of it waits for permission, and none of it waits to be asked.

That's what going first into the cost actually looks like.

#faith #leadership #christianmen #character #manofgod
theme: He leads by going first into the cost.
